entities.name: Early Settlement: Tobacco and Cotton
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The initial colonial economy based on tobacco, cotton, and indigo cultivation by English settlers and indentured servants (including many Irish). Small-scale farming predominated before the sugar revolution.
